## Load libraries
If the libraries are not installed yet, you need to install them using, for example, the command: install.packages("ggplot2").
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggExtra)
library(gridExtra)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggridges)
```

# Load Data

```{r}
performance.mlp <- read.csv("~/Github/UpperPalCombinatorics/results/classifier/MLP/performance/performance_MLP_tanh_sse_rprop+_Aurignacien_Cuneiform (Uruk V)_.csv")
head(performance.mlp)
```

# Density Plots

## Accuracy
Density plot for lengths in number of characters.
```{r}
accuracy.plot <- ggplot(performance.mlp, aes(x = accuracy)) + 
  # add density ridges with quantiles = 2, i.e. median as a line
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5)
accuracy.plot
```
